title: Road Attention and Eyes-Off-Road Mentions
summary: This topic groups mixed road-visibility and driver-attention comments, with clear sentiment only in a few fragments and many examples too vague or unrelated to support a single coherent issue.

positive.summary: Positive reviews mention good road conditions or a generally good feeling while driving.

negative.summary: Negative feedback says the monitoring or interface behavior makes brief instrument checks feel too difficult without taking eyes off the road.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention taking eyes off the road, visibility behind the vehicle, wind noise, or other road-related observations without a clear overall evaluation.

limitations: The cluster mixes multiple subjects, including driver attention, control usability, rear visibility, road conditions, and wind noise, rather than one clearly defined theme.
Most fragments are undetermined, so the examples are insufficient to draw a clear sentiment pattern beyond the few explicitly labeled positive and negative comments.
Some positive examples are generic driving-context statements rather than direct evaluations of a specific feature.
